title: Bulk lattice optimization of Pt and Pt₃Sn
action: Optimize the bulk lattice constants of fcc Pt and Pt₃Sn using DFT with the GGA-PBE functional and PAW pseudopotentials. The Pt₃Sn structure is a simple cubic cell with space group Pm-3m.
description: Evidence JSON recording the optimized lattice parameters (Å) and total energies (eV) for Pt and Pt₃Sn. This step generates the bulk references needed for all subsequent slab constructions.

title: Simulated XRD of Pt and Pt₃Sn
action: Using the optimized bulk structures, compute powder X-ray diffraction patterns with Cu-Kα radiation (λ = 1.5406 Å) to obtain lists of (2θ, intensity) peaks for both materials.
description: Evidence JSON with peak positions and intensities. Used to document the structural setup and verify lattice expansion in Pt₃Sn.

title: Slab model construction and relaxation
action: Build six-layer p(2×2) slabs for Pt(100), Pt(110), Pt₃Sn(100), and Pt₃Sn(110) using the optimized bulk lattice parameters, with 14 Å vacuum. Relax the top four layers while fixing the bottom two at bulk positions. Use the same functional and pseudopotentials as for the bulk.
description: Evidence JSON with the total energies (eV) of the relaxed clean slabs for the four surfaces.

title: Hydrogen adsorption energy calculations
action: For each relaxed slab, place a single H atom at the most stable adsorption site (top, bridge, or hollow) and relax the H position together with the top four layers. Also compute the total energy of an isolated H₂ molecule in a periodic box. Calculate the adsorption energy ΔE_H* = E(slab+H*) − E(slab) − ½ E(H₂).
description: Evidence JSON containing the ΔE_H* values (eV) for each surface.

title: HER free energy diagram computation
action: From the most stable ΔE_H* site on each surface, compute the Gibbs free energy of hydrogen adsorption ΔG_H* = ΔE_H* + ΔZPE − TΔS + ΔG_pH at T = 298 K and pH = 0. Include zero-point energy and entropy corrections. Report the four ΔG_H* values (in eV) and their ordering from smallest to largest absolute magnitude.
description: Final ΔG_H* values and ordering for Pt(100), Pt(110), Pt₃Sn(100), and Pt₃Sn(110). This is the main scored artifact; the pipeline must be run to obtain these quantities.
output_schema:
{
  "Pt_100_dG": float (eV),
  "Pt_110_dG": float (eV),
  "Pt3Sn_100_dG": float (eV),
  "Pt3Sn_110_dG": float (eV),
  "ordering": [string] sorted from smallest to largest |ΔG_H*| (most favorable first)
}
